scope: Documented independent Java/Spring and MySQL/MariaDB workflows on Windows; no claim of complete IntelliJ IDEA or DataGrip parity.
nodeEvidenceScope: The MySQL run retains its original input vector. A separately audited single native-host empty-directory cleanup correction changes no runtime or Node-test dependency input, and is verified by the final native runs. The MariaDB run uses the final vector directly.
limitations: This validates documented supported scopes, not original-product parity or all Java semantics.

Move supports one saved plain public class without inheritance/nested types in one imported project/source root. Known accessibility, resource/framework, dynamic lookup and path conflicts refuse; remaining semantic/external-client conflicts require review and compilation.

Change Signature supports plain non-polymorphic methods/constructors with direct project callers, parameter reorder, compatible literal-default addition and unused removal. Overloads, inheritance, framework contracts, arbitrary evaluation effects and external binary/reflection callers remain unsupported.

Safe Delete supports unused plain private methods and package-private final class files under saved local project/reference coverage. Private-method edits support native Undo; closed-editor file Ctrl+Z is not claimed. File deletion has explicit non-overwriting original-byte restoration with session-only bounded one-hour tokens. Framework entries, constructors, fields, computed reflection and external consumers are not proven absent.
Native WorkspaceEdit text changes remain unsaved; resource move/delete affects disk. Validation narrows stale-source races but is not atomic against arbitrary external filesystem writers.
Reference scans, project/file sizes, plan lifetimes and Java/import/runtime combinations are bounded. The final matrices retain all other implementation gaps.
The progress value is a feature-count reference score; it is not a labor percentage.
Public repository creation/push and its visibility/current commit are separate publication evidence; this private report does not infer publication from local validation.
ci: Maintainer-local validation is separate from the public Windows Node22 CI workflow. See this repository Actions for the actual result of each pushed commit.
